narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think every grid has only one filling, because the border sum is fixed.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Some grids let you choose a corner freely, and the other cells then follow.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Different choices give different fillings, and every one of them reaches the border sum.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says every grid has only one filling; two different fillings of the same grid, for example grid C with top right 1 and again with top right 2, are shown side by side with the same border sum; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, add all four sides of a finished grid. Each total must equal the border sum.
<bookmark mark='free'/>Your numbers may differ from ours when there is a free choice, and that is fine.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: add all four sides of each finished grid and compare each total with the border sum
